(3) SUPER ADMIN /approvals -> opens cx, sees cx-approve/cx-reject/cx-revision all present, cx-cancellation_fee editable, clicks Approve -> booking CANCELLED, refund auto-created (visible on tab-refund with rf-open-<id> = 1 QA8 refund CALCULATED). (5) SUPER ADMIN refund -> rf-approve visible, clicks Approve -> APPROVED. (6) ACCOUNTING refund detail after approval -> rf-process button now VISIBLE (canProcess=true), fills rf-pay-amount=17jt, rf-pay-bank=BCA, rf-pay-date, clicks Process -> status REFUNDED (badge emerald 'REFUNDED', refunded_amount Rp 17.000.000, toast 'Pembayaran refund tercatat'). All data-testids from the spec are present and behave per RBAC.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown further (Phase 8 adds ~600 lines of cancellation/refund endpoints, models, helpers, notification fan-out) — consider extracting a phase8/cancellation_refund router module and a shared notifications helper.

Approvals.jsx doApprove sends the whole rev dict (fee, non_refundable_cost, supplier_cost, other_deduction) via spread and also passes proposed_refund on refund approve — good, matches spec (SA can override); worth documenting that the backend must recompute estimated_refund server-side to prevent tampering (already does per test — keep the guard).

RefundDetail canApprove includes 'CALCULATED' as an acceptable state; happy path goes CALCULATED -> ACCOUNTING_REVIEWED -> APPROVED. If SA approves directly from CALCULATED (skipping accounting review), bank details will not be captured before payout. Consider forcing ACCOUNTING_REVIEWED before approve, or clearly document the SA-bypass path.

BookingDetail: request-cancellation-button is hidden only when status is exactly 'CANCELLED'; should also hide/disable for 'PARTIALLY_CANCELLED' if no travelers remain assignable, otherwise sales can raise a second full cancel on an already partially cancelled booking. Backend appears to guard this — cosmetic UI polish only.
Approvals.jsx CX_COLORS is missing style for 'PARTIALLY_CANCELLED' cancellation state — no visual regression today because status label is on booking, not cancellation, but worth aligning.
